dataList.content:
<... Did we just fight the Peccatula?>
<……罪种？刚才那个，是罪种吗？>

Yes.
正是如此。

Their appearances are rather dissimilar from what we have encountered afore. They appear to have grown more... acute...
外观与以往相遇时有所不同。似乎更为深化……

They are evolutions of each Peccatula.
这是罪种更进一步的形态。

The kind of Peccatula one transforms into depends on the types of Sin that one has embodied in life, so it is no surprise that there may be variations to them.
由于每个人内含的罪种性质不同，因此它们的形态可以是多种多样的。

But... we've never encountered anything like them before.
但是……从来没有出现过这种形态的个体。

Collecting the Golden Boughs could have expedited the Peccatula growth process.
回收金枝同样也会促进罪种的成长。

Those boughs... they really have something to do with everything, huh? Our job is starting to look a lot more serious...
那种枝条……这世上到处都是受其影响的东西。比想象中还要厉害啊……

Right, that reminds me. These 'Peccatula' are each supposed to represent some kinda 'Sin', right?
仔细想来，这些罪种……应该是某种“罪”的象征吧？

My thoughts grow distant all of a sudden.
忽然间，我的思绪愈行愈远。

... No. The Sinners grow distant while my thoughts draw nearer. Their voices grow muffled.
不……更确切地说，我的思绪逐渐拉近，而罪人们的话语则愈行愈远。

The word 'Sin' feels oddly unfamiliar today.
突然间，“罪”这个字显得格外陌生。

It appears that they have lost their sense of self; their original forms now forgotten to oblivion.
迷失自我，失去了原本的模样。

Self...
自我……

Aren't Distortions kinda similar to that?
扭曲不就是类似的东西吗？

Hmm... some people become Distortions, and some people become Peccatula... I wonder what the difference is?
有些人变成扭曲，有些人变成罪种……是依据了什么标准呢。

I think... I think I know...
我好像……有些明白了……

<... Planted in the hearts of all are seeds with ever-present potential to bloom.>
<……每个人的心中都有一颗蕴藏着开花可能性的种子。>

Executive Manager?
执行经理？

What'dya say? Fau talked over ya, so I couldn't hear...
你说啥？跟小浮解释的声音重叠了，我听不清你的话……

... If you would allow me to continue... Maintaining the self even at times of extreme stress could cause one to evolve into a Distortion, and—
……那么说明继续。如果能在极端压力下保持自我，就会发展成扭曲……

<When the light of that day descends upon the hearts of every human, blooming the seeds buried deep within...>
<当那一天的光芒照耀着人们的心，使那埋藏的种子绽放之时……>

... Manager?
……经理？

<If one's ■■■■ ■■ ■■■■■■■■, devoured by their sins, they are reborn in the form of the ■■■■■■■■■, their image reflecting the ■■■■■■■ ■■■■■ ■■ ■■■ ■■■■ dreamt by those who are nothing.>
<被罪孽吞噬后■■■■■，通过那些非此亦非彼的人们梦想中的■■■■■■，以■■的形式重生。>

Dante.
但丁。

Dante! What is—
但丁！没事吧……

<If one withstands ■■■ ■■■■■■ ■■ ■■■■■ ■■■■, yet ■■■■■■■ ■■ ■■■■■■ ■■ their sins, the heart ■■■■■■■■...>
<如果承受了■■■■■，但却■■■■自己的罪，其心灵将会■■……>

W-what the hell... Clockhead, what in the bloody hell are you talking about?
什、什么玩意儿……钟表头……突然在嘀咕什么呢？

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
I ill like the sound of that... Has something gone awry with their prosthetic head...?
听起来很严重的声响……是头部义体出了什么问题吗……

<Yet if one seeks to bear the ■■■■ ■■■■■■■■■■■■ ■■ ■■■■■ ■■■■, the ■■■ shall ■■■■■■ ■■■ ■■■■■ of their original hearts...>
<如果接受并背负了■■■■，其心灵原本■■■■■■■为■■■……>

E.G.O? Is that what you are speaking of?
E.G.O？这就是你所说之事吗？

<And in a world perceived through their own ■■■■■ ■■ ■■■ ■■■■■■■■ ■■■ ■■■ ■■■■■■, the ■■■■■■■ shall be unveiled: to ■■■■■ their egos ■■■ ■■■■■■■■... ■■ ■■ melt into ■■■ ■■■■■ by ■■■■■■■■ ■■■■ ■■ ■■■■ ■■■■■ ■■■■■■ of sin...>
<在以自己的■■看待的世界里……只有挥舞着自我■■■■，■■■■■仅属于自己的罪■■■，才能逐渐融入■■……>

Huh, they're starting to talk a bit like my grandfa— Huh?! M-manager! Your head!
说话的语气有点像我的爷爷……诶？！执行经理！头！

Executive Manager! Y-your head is on fire!
执行经理！头、头烧起来了！

Ooh~ what a blaze.
哦~火。

I-I think they're about to explode!
肯、肯定快要爆炸了？！

<Only those who can define their own ■■■■...>
<只有那些能够掩盖住自己的■■的人……>

Oi! We've got to do something before Clockhead bites it! Got any bright ideas, lass?!
喂！这么放着不管那家伙要死了吧！有什么办法吗？

I-I know not what to do...!
吾、吾不知该如何是好……！

<Only those who are awakened to their own ■■■■■...>
<只有那些能够意识到自己的■■的人……>

Gaaah! 'T-tis scorching! I had thought that Manager Esquire's flaming head was merely for style, for I had not once felt such heat from it...!
啊啊！好、好烫！经理老爷头上的火一直不怎么旺，吾还以为只是装饰呢……

Faust! What if they accidentally activated the self-destruct sequence?! Agh, this heat... if we don't douse it now, it's going to melt everything around them...!
浮士德小姐！是不是那时候说的自爆装置启动了？！这热量、肯定什么都能融化吧……

... Yes, the operating principles are the same. Dante is, via the Golden Boughs, connected to the root of the sapling planted in the subterranean area of the headquarters. Which is to say that—
……其工作原理是一样的。但丁通过金枝与一棵栽种在本部地下的树苗的根部相连，也就是说……

Who gives a shite about the Boughs?! We've got to douse the flames on their head!
谁在乎那破树枝！得赶紧把那个火熄灭啊！

Water! Doest nay one have water? We must make haste and douse the flames!
水！谁有水？！快、快点灭火……

Some time later...
不久之后……

Pray tell, art thou recover'd?!
回过神来了吗？！

My eyes—if I had eyes, that is—opened slowly. I was lying on the ground, surrounded by the Sinners.
睁开眼，视野逐渐开阔，我看见罪人们低头看着自己。

<What... happened?>
<发生了什么……？>

Do you not recall what had transpired?
不记得了吗？

<Uh... I guess I don't?>
<唔……似乎……是的。>

I do remember walking up the stairs... and suddenly feeling really dizzy.
我明明记得自己走在楼梯上，之后脑袋突然变得一片空白。

Executive Manager. You must visit a workshop to get that looked at as soon as we return...
……经理，回去之后请一定要接受维修。

<Huh? A workshop? Did I malfunction or something?>
<诶？维修？我坏了吗？>

Don't talk about them like you're talking about some machine... Haah, either way, there isn't anything we can do about what just happened. Not here.
怎么像是在说机器一样……哈啊，反正现在也无能为力。

We can discuss this later once we return. What just transpired does not seem to pose any hindrance to our mission.
回去后再讨论吧。总之，应该不会影响到我们的行动。

<Aeng-du, where is...>
<樱桃小姐去哪了……>

She has advanced without us. While I remain curious yet concerned about your condition, we must reconvene with her. The situation calls for urgency.
她已经上去了……即使我仍有许多疑惑与顾虑，我们还是尽早会合为好。

<Yeah... okay.>
<唔……好吧。>

There was a lot I didn't understand, but since we're in the middle of an operation...
虽然仍有许多难以理解的事情，但最重要的，我们还在作战当中呢……

... let's deal with this first.
先集中精力解决主要问题吧。
